Both individuals lean forward, each using a straw to take a drink, their facial expressions shifting from anticipation to wide-eyed surprise and broad smiles. He points at the package while speaking animatedly. The woman watches him and reacts with a surprised expression, leaning in to look at the new fruit bag.
